pitch:
Yu Chun Korean Restaurant, 1159 Kapiolani Blvd, Honolulu, near Ala Moana Center. Open 11 AM to 9 PM daily.
Signature: chik naengmyeon, chewy black arrowroot noodles. In ice-cold tangy broth, with spicy sauce, or in warm soup: $18.95. With spicy sauce and raw fish: $21.95.
Extra noodles $7. Also kalbi ($38.95), bulgogi ($35.95), mandoo and stews ($20.95 to $24.95).
Prices before tax. 20% gratuity added for parties of 5 or more.
Walk in for 4 or fewer; call to reserve for 5+. Cash and credit cards.
